run_whisper_evaluation: run a Whisper model evaluation on long-form speech transcription datasets with WER metrics
convert_dataset_str_to_list: convert a plus-separated dataset string into a list of dataset config dictionaries
compute_metrics: compute WER, IER, SER, DER, and repeated n-gram metrics for speech recognition predictions
write_wandb_pred: write audio predictions and ground truth labels as a table to Weights & Biases
eval_step: evaluate a Whisper model on a dataset split and log metrics to tensorboard or wandb
